note: The Type-1 tiered funnel. Everyone answers the entry screener; deeper ones appear only when the quick screen or the stated domain points to them. Deep-dive thresholds are PROVISIONAL until clinician sign-off.

domainTriggers.because: A grief, loss or big-change domain is where an unresolved traumatic event most often sits.

The person named loneliness or relationships. Symptom screeners measure how bad someone feels, not how alone they are, so this is the one domain the funnel could not see — and it is the domain a group answers better than an individual session.

severityTriggers.because: At a moderate band or above, knowing whether alcohol is in the picture changes which resources are useful.
